## Reading problem

What job should this help with, and when does the current firmware make it difficult?

## Proposed behaviour

Describe the smallest useful behaviour. Mention what should happen on the screen and what should happen after Back or a return to reading.

## Button path

Describe the complete button sequence for selection, confirmation, cancellation, and return to reading. The Xteink X3 has no touch input.

## Constraints

Mention storage, performance, memory, localisation, or PagePet considerations that matter for this idea.
